name: Crack a fetch on turn 1-2 for a basic that unlocks a hand card, never paying life
intent: Against boros-aggro, boros-energy and ur-cutter-prowess - the format's fast aggressive decks - open-shock-unlocks and open-fetch-unlocks both stand down rather than spend 2 life on turn 1 or 2. This play covers the same fetch-for-an-unlock need against exactly those three archetypes, restricted to finding a basic (never a shockland, so pay_life is always declined) - a Swamp or Island in the library that makes some other hand card payable. Triggers on unlocks_by_basic_search, not the broader unlocks_by_search: a fetch whose own search can only reach a non-basic unlock (a shockland the library holds but no basic) must never be cracked by this play, since its own choose_cards pick is restricted to a basic and would fail to find one - wasting the fetch and the shuffle for nothing (failing hand vs boros-aggro T1: Flooded Strand, Island, Thoughtseize, Psychic Frog, Fatal Push, with only a library Watery Grave reachable - this play must not crack Strand for that). Same fetch-selection prefer as open-fetch-unlocks (a fetch whose other search target is Plains, dimir-frog's dead colour, ahead of Polluted Delta, which has no dead half) and the same untapped-and-can-actually-reach-it restriction on the crack source. Stands down once open-land-unlocks would already fire (U's own key), the library is down to 5 cards or fewer, or life is 1 or less - the fetch's own draw-a-card-less shuffle still costs a turn even when it costs no life, and a seat at 1 life has bigger problems than a free basic. Only turns 1-2, land drop available, mine, precombat main, empty stack.
